newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle active at $69, up $1-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle active at $69, up $1-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sold at $69.00 per cwt in active trading, up $1.00 from light sales Monday and last week's heavy volume, feedlot sources said.
About 40,000 head sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and about 45,000 in Kansas, they said.

Fed cattle prices were lifted by higher beef prices and smaller numbers of market-ready cattle following active sales last week that included the pulling forward of cattle from this week's lists, they said.
Beef prices were firm on continued retailer buying for the Memorial Day holiday weekend, market sources said.
